transcript: I wanna talk about the end of Operation Mincemeat, because tonight I got to see the new cast. And there was a moment at the end of the show that hit me so hard, I literally gasped out loud. And then after the show, I was texting with my friends in London, and they were like, no, that's how the show ends every night. And tonight was the first night I've ever caught it. So spoilers ahead if you haven't seen mincemeat. This is past the glitzy finale. This is at the very end, where they're telling the story of Glinda and Michael. And as they're telling the story, the cast starts to kind of undress and character themselves. Hester takes off her glasses. Her physicality is kind of starts to strip away, and you see them sort of transform from the characters in the show to the actors themselves. And I did know that, but then they reprise sale on voice. And this is why I think it hit me so hard tonight. They did it in their American accents. This is the first all American cast of Operation Mincemeat. Before this, they had the original British cast. And, yes, they had American understudies. But when the understudies went on during that moment, they kept their accents. The Brits are going back to their natural accents, but the Americans would keep a British accent because otherwise it would sound weird. I confirm this with a member of the cast. But now it ends with them all going back to being American. And it just hit me so hard. It was so beautiful. It was just like this really beautiful moment of these actors being like, we've told you the story, and now we're going back to ourselves, and now we are still sailing on together. We will be telling the story again. Like, I don't know, very Hadestown. Telling the story again and again and again. But, yeah, I guess that's how it's always ended. I just didn't know because I couldn't tell the difference between their show British accents and their natural British accents. But when they're going from show British accents to their natural American accents, I'm like, sobbing. I got a full video coming on this cast, but, um, I really want to talk about this specifically cause I still can't stop thinking about it. But I love them so much. I love this show.
